description: This is a shell script used for testing git rebase interactive rewording features. It sets up a repository, performs rebase operations, and verifies commit messages and history integrity through various test scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes, typically cleanup.

methods.name: reset_rebase
methods.description: Resets the rebase state in the Git repository.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor to automate rebase message editing during tests.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, verifying error handling.
